react_result.final_narrative_text: Three independent pathway-analysis paradigms converge on Glycine, serine and threonine metabolism (KEGG:hsa00260 / KEGG:map00260) as the dominant signal in this nine-metabolite differential set. RaMP multi-DB ORA reports FDR 1.30×10⁻⁸ with four hits (L-threonine, L-glutamic acid, choline, dihydrolipoic acid); mummichog m/z-network analysis returns p=0.0024 with matching hits (L-glutamate, choline, L-threonine plus network-propagated analogues); MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA confirms rank-1 with p=0.004 for choline and L-threonine. The four driver metabolites map to distinct branch points in this pathway: L-threonine enters via threonine aldolase; L-glutamate is the transamination product of 2-oxoglutarate (also input as oxoglutaric acid) and feeds the glycine cleavage system; choline is oxidised to betaine entering the one-carbon folate pool; dihydrolipoate links to folate metabolism through dihydrolipoyl dehydrogenase (E3 component). A secondary consensus emerges for Nicotinamide metabolism (KEGG:hsa00760 / map00760): RaMP FDR 6.97×10⁻⁴ and MetaboAnalystR p=0.046 both hit niacinamide and L-glutamate, and mummichog independently scores vitamin B3 metabolism p=0.0126. Phosphate (inorganic) and pyruvate appear as co-substrates in the glycolysis–TCA interface but do not achieve cross-paradigm significance in amino-acid-specific enrichment; their perturbation is consistent with the energetic downstream effect of amino-acid catabolism. Isopentenyl diphosphate (terpene precursor) hits only mummichog N-glycan biosynthesis (p=0.046), likely a secondary signal. Overall the biological story is treatment-induced activation of one-carbon amino-acid catabolism and NAD⁺ salvage, with consistent perturbation of the threonine–glycine–folate node and secondary niacinamide (NAD⁺ precursor) involvement.

final_react_result.final_narrative_text: Three independent pathway-analysis paradigms converge on Glycine, serine and threonine metabolism (KEGG:hsa00260) as the dominant signal. RaMP multi-DB ORA reports FDR 8.19e-06 for KEGG:map00260, MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA reports p=0.004 for hsa00260, and Mummichog m/z-network analysis returns p=0.0025 for MUMM:glycine_serine_alanine_and_threonine_metabolism. The driver metabolites shared across all three tools are choline (KEGG:C00114) and L-threonine (KEGG:C00188). RaMP also hits L-glutamic acid (KEGG:C00025) in the same pathway. A secondary consensus emerges from Mummichog at rank 1 (p=0.013) for Vitamin B3 (nicotinate and nicotinamide) metabolism, where niacinamide (KEGG:C00153) and L-glutamic acid (KEGG:C00025) are network-propagated hits. MetaboAnalystR independently reports hsa00760 (Nicotinamide metabolism) at p=0.046 with niacinamide as the sole hit. Isopentenyl diphosphate (KEGG:C00129) appears in Mummichog N-glycan biosynthesis (p=0.050) and represents a secondary signal consistent with terpenoid biosynthesis. The biological story is treatment-induced activation of Glycine, serine and threonine metabolism.
